verdict.rationale: Justworks documents its own 'Analytics > Custom Payroll Report', where employers review employee payroll information, so a first-party payroll reporting capability exists. The evidence gives no detail on its contents and never mentions a payroll register, a gross-to-net breakdown, or exporting the report (e.g., CSV/Excel). The Xero pay-type mapping is an accounting sync rather than a report export, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit payroll register report, gross-to-net report detail, documented export formats, independent or hands-on corroboration.
